item.description:
Formula 0.1.53

  • Accounts: one account for each agent, so a second Claude or Codex account can no longer be added (#95)
  • Ideas: reviewing a design is a guided walk-through with the whole window, and drawings no longer carry confusing controls of their own (#92)
  • Settings: every setting is on the new screens (general, repositories, releases, agents, Slack and tickets, notifications, data, other) (#93)
  • Ideas: a build picked up again skips the stages it had finished, and its clock carries on (#91)
  • Shipping: Agents, Released, All open pull requests, Ask for reviews and GitHub status are on the new screens, with Pause automation (#90)
